title: docs: sync, consolidate, and reorder all-contributor list
author: adiati98
body:
## Description

This PR fixes the drift between `README.md`'s contributor table and `.all-contributorsrc` on the 7.2 branch, with below details:

- Added the 23 contributors that were listed in `README.md` but missing from `.all-contributorsrc`. This happened because the all-contributors bot had been opening its "add contributor" PRs against 7.1 instead of 7.2, so 7.2's `.all-contributorsrc` never picked up those additions.
- Restored `patrykgruszka`'s review contribution credit, which was missing from `.all-contributorsrc`.
- Ordered the added entries chronologically, based on when each person's "add contributor" PR was merged.
- `README.md` needed no changes. It was already correct and complete.
